review_candidates.title: Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: About MOHM MOHM specializes in workplace and office furniture solutions designed to support the functional, technical, and aesthetic needs of modern work environments. We work closely with corporate clients, consultants, designers, contractors, and project management teams to deliver furniture solutions across different types and scales of workplace projects. About the Role We are looking for a proactive and commercially driven Office Furniture Projects Sales Engineer who can actively generate leads, identify new project opportunities, and convert them into confirmed orders. The successful candidate will manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting and approaching potential clients to understanding project requirements, preparing commercial offers, negotiating, closing, and ensuring the client remains satisfied throughout the experience. Key Responsibilities * Actively generate new leads and build a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities. * Search for upcoming office, administrative, commercial, and fit-out projects. * Identify and approach potential corporate clients, consultants, contractors, designers, developers, and project managers. * Develop new accounts through calls, meetings, referrals, networking, site visits, and market research. * Maintain continuous follow-up with prospects to convert leads into active opportunities. * Understand client requirements, project specifications, layouts, and BOQs. * Recommend suitable furniture products and workplace solutions. * Coordinate with the Design and Technical Office teams to prepare proposals. * Prepare and present technical and commercial quotations. * Follow up on submitted offers and maintain regular communication with clients. * Maintain accurate lead, opportunity, and pipeline information through the CRM. * Coordinate internally with planning, production, logistics, and installation teams. * Follow up on project execution, delivery, installation, and client satisfaction. * Achieve assigned lead generation, pipeline, sales, and collection targets. Requirements * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, Applied Arts, Business, or a related field. * Previous experience in office furniture sales is strongly preferred. * Relevant experience in furniture, interior fit-out, architectural products, building materials, contracting, construction, real estate, or other project-based B2B fields will also be considered. * Proven experience in prospecting, lead generation, and developing new business opportunities. * Proven experience in B2B or project-based sales. * Ability to understand project requirements, layouts, technical specifications, and BOQs. * Demonstrated ability to negotiate and close high-value sales opportunities. * Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills. * Good command of English and Microsoft Office. * Experience using a CRM system is preferred. What We Are Looking For * A proactive salesperson who actively searches for opportunities rather than depending only on assigned leads. * Strong commercial awareness and a results-oriented mindset. * Strong ownership and consistent follow-up. * A professional and customer-focused approach. * The ability to understand both technical requirements and commercial priorities. * Strong planning, coordination, and problem-solving skills.

review_candidates.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer (Operations Software & Tools)
review_candidates.description: A global leader in semiconductor manufacturing is seeking a Sr Staff Software Engineer (Operations Software & Tools) to drive the design, development, and rollout of custom software and factory automation solutions in its Bayan Lepas, Malaysia facility. This full-time, on-site role focuses on integrating systems with MES and manufacturing floor equipment to enhance factory efficiency, yield, and productivity while leading end-to-end project execution in close cross-functional partnership with OED, OPS, ISD, SW&D, and Product Line groups. Key Responsibilities Build & maintain custom software tools and automation for Operations Engineering and the manufacturing floor. Integrate shop-floor equipment and MES via SECS/GEM to enable equipment connectivity, tool control, and real-time monitoring. Develop & deploy containerized applications (Docker/Kubernetes) that connect operations systems and PMO workflows. Drive projects from initiation through delivery — scope, schedule, risk, resourcing — interfacing with stakeholders across functions. Define & improve engineering and project-management processes and standards (issue tracking, requirements management, progress metrics). Collaborate with IT and third-party vendors on infrastructure, cloud, security, and shared tooling to keep solutions scalable and supportable. Qualifications MUST have Bachelor's in Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. 8–10 years in software development / engineering (semiconductor or factory-operations environment strongly preferred). Strong software engineering fundamentals across Windows & Linux — core languages such as Python and C/C++ (C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, Groovy, BASH a plus). Hands-on factory-automation / equipment-integration experience — MES integration and equipment connectivity via SECS/GEM (SEMI E5/E30). Containerization & deployment: Docker, Kubernetes. English proficiency (written & verbal). GOOD to have Broader software toolchain familiarity (make files, compilers, assemblers, linkers). Experience with shop-floor tool interfaces and real-time equipment monitoring at scale. JIRA & Confluence for tracking, requirements, and process. Japanese or Chinese language proficiency If interested, kindly click 'Apply' to submit your application.

review_candidates.title: Full Stack Software Engineer (Tech Lead) - Clearance Preferred
review_candidates.description: Overview We're looking for a Full Stack Tech Lead with deep expertise across the frontend (React, TypeScript, CSS, HTML) and backend (C# / .NET, Entity Framework (or Java Spring Boot) , relational databases) stack to lead our logistics app team. Beyond hands-on coding, you'll own the systems architecture for a scalable data ingest pipeline spanning edge and cloud environments. You'll set technical direction, mentor frontend and backend engineers, and drive systems design decisions across the platform. Working closely with product owners, designers, and fellow engineers, you'll iterate quickly on features, improve performance, and build out a secure, scalable platform for real-world military and government users. This role blends technical leadership, architectural ownership, and hands-on coding, spanning everything from UI workflows to distributed backend services to deployment automation. Who We Are We’re not here to maintain the status quo, we’re here to rewrite it and innovate at the pace of need. Our team is laser-focused on creating cutting-edge RFID solutions for the DoD that bring passive and active RFID tech to life, solving tough integration challenges across global sites. We're a no-bench, get-after-it kind of company where initiative is rewarded, and innovation is our default setting. If you’re ready to dive in, take ownership, and ship real value, keep reading. LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed. Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value. Responsibilities What You'll Do Own the end-to-end systems architecture for a scalable, resilient data ingest pipeline spanning edge and cloud, built on Redis, RabbitMQ, and custom services. Lead and mentor a team of frontend and backend engineers, guiding technical decisions, conducting code reviews, and establishing best practices and documentation. Drive full-stack systems design decisions, from distributed data flows and message queuing to API architecture, data models, and UI component structure. Lead an AI-enabled development team, owning the guardrails, validation layers, end-to-end tests, and supporting systems that keep AI-assisted output safe, reliable, and production-grade. Break down product and design requirements into clear, workable, well-scoped engineering tasks and distribute them effectively across the team. Build intuitive, responsive front-end experiences using React and modern component libraries, translating requirements into clean, reusable UI components. Write clean, secure back-end services using C# / .NET, with a focus on REST APIs, modular design, and optimized data access layers using Entity Framework. Collaborate across design, product, DevSecOps , and field teams to launch features quickly and securely. Drive rapid prototyping cycles while enforcing production-grade coding standards across the team. Champion automated testing and code quality gates by writing and reviewing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests. Troubleshoot bugs, squash performance bottlenecks, and help build toward FedRAMP and IL5 deployment requirements. Qualifications What We're Looking For 6+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including prior experience leading or mentoring engineers. Demonstrated ownership of systems architecture and design for distributed, scalable systems—ideally data ingest or streaming pipelines spanning edge and cloud environments. Hands-on experience with distributed systems components such as Redis, RabbitMQ (or comparable message brokers), and custom service development. Experience leading an AI-enabled development team, including owning the guardrails, validation, end-to-end testing, and support systems needed to safely and reliably ship AI-assisted work. Full stack proficiency across frontend and backend, with demonstrated ability to make architectural decisions spanning both. Strong frontend skills: React (component design, hooks, modern front-end patterns), JavaScript/TypeScript, and a solid grasp of HTML, CSS, and responsive design principles. Strong backend skills: C# and modern .NET, with hands-on experience in Entity Framework and relational databases, plus a solid understanding of SQL, indexing, and query optimization. Familiarity with dependency injection, async/await, and LINQ. Deep understanding of systems design and the relationship between frontend and backend systems, including state management, REST APIs, async data fetching, and event-driven/asynchronous messaging patterns. Experience with testing tools across the stack (e.g., Jest, Vitest , React Testing Library) and a track record of building automated validation and end-to-end testing into delivery. Proven ability to turn product and design requirements into workable, well-scoped engineering tasks. Familiarity with secure software development practices and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, etc ). Comfortable leading in Agile or Lean environments, with rapid delivery cycles and direct user feedback loops. US Citizenship with the ability to obtain and maintain a government security clearance. Active Secret or TS clearance preferred Bonus Points For Hands-on work with secure government environments (DoD, IL5+, FedRAMP). Experience building logistics, supply chain, or asset tracking applications. Certifications like Security+ and AWS Developer/Architect. Past experience at a startup or in rapid-growth teams. Target Salary Range: $130,000 - 200,000 Final compensation will be determined by a variety of factors including but not limited to your skills, experience, education, and/or certifications. Job Locations US-Remote
